note: WS-J (2026-06-30). Domain-specific MCP tool packs: agents get a BOUNDED capability set, not raw access to every tool. Each pack lists allowed tools, explicitly denied tools, tools that require human approval (write/publish/delete), a per-context tool budget, and whether every call must be traced. The quality_gate 'mcp-governance' check validates a run's toolTrace (AIR.toolTrace / runTraceService ToolTraceStep) against these packs. Figma MCP is DESIGN-TIME ONLY: the SPA never calls Figma live at runtime (it uses the exported manifest + token/component/image-slot registries). Descriptors are untrusted unless signed + pinned (descriptor_signature).

packs.purpose: Design-time auditing/export of GOLD pages + token/component parity. NEVER runtime.
